title: Scaling Therapy Supervision: Assessing Psychotherapy Fidelity Using Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.28772v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Psychotherapy fidelity assessment measures how faithfully a therapist adheres to a treatment protocol, a critical determinant of positive patient outcomes. However, fidelity assessment is bottlenecked by manual expert review, rendering the process labor-intensive and unscalable. To scale therapy supervision and support clinician self-learning, we present an integrated application of large language models (LLMs) that automates psychotherapy fidelity workflows and generates actionable supervisory feedback from authentic, long-form clinical transcripts. We evaluate three open-weight models across multiple task decomposition configurations and reasoning strategies, demonstrating that evidence-first reasoning improves fidelity estimation. Furthermore, we establish the framework's external construct validity on an independent randomized controlled trial (RCT), where it reliably distinguishes Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) from non-CBT sess

translated_title: 扩展心理治疗督导规模：利用大型语言模型评估心理治疗保真度
translated_abstract: 心理治疗保真度评估用于衡量治疗师对治疗方案的遵循程度，这是患者获得积极疗效的关键决定因素。然而，保真度评估一直受限于人工专家评审，使这一过程既费力又难以规模化。为了扩展治疗督导的规模并支持临床医生的自我学习，我们提出了一种大型语言模型（LLM）的集成应用，该应用能够自动化心理治疗保真度评估工作流程，并从真实的临床长篇会谈记录中生成可操作的督导反馈。我们在多种任务分解配置和推理策略下评估了三个开源权重模型，结果表明“证据优先”的推理方式能够提升保真度估计的效果。此外，我们在一项独立的随机对照试验（RCT）上验证了该框架的外部构念效度，在该试验中，该框架能够可靠地区分认知行为疗法（CBT）与非CBT会谈。
tldr: 该研究利用大型语言模型自动化心理治疗保真度评估并生成可操作的督导反馈，摆脱了人工专家评审的瓶颈，实现了治疗督导的可规模化，并在随机对照试验数据上验证了其区分CBT与非CBT会谈的有效性。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that large language models can automate psychotherapy fidelity assessment and generate actionable supervisory feedback from authentic clinical transcripts, enabling scalable therapy supervision beyond manual expert review, with validated ability to reliably distinguish CBT from non-CBT sessions on independent RCT data.
